question: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the nationwide Pulse Self-Reliance Mission from which district?
solution:
**The correct answer is __Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the nationwide Pulse Self-Reliance Mission from the Food Legumes Research Centre (FLRP) in Amlaha, Sehore district of Madhya Pradesh. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The mission aims to make India self-reliant in pulse production.
 
• It focuses on a cluster-based production model and seed villages.
 
• The roadmap includes setting up 1,000 pulse mills across the country.
 
• The initiative supports the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The launch event was attended by Union Ministers, State Chief Ministers, Deputy Chief Ministers, and Agriculture Ministers from various states.
 
• The initiative seeks to strengthen research–farmer linkages and boost pulse exports.
